nodes.label: Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO)
nodes.rationale: Variational lower bound on marginal log-likelihood decomposing into reconstruction negative log-likelihood and analytical KL divergence.

nodes.label: Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) Prior
nodes.rationale: Multimodal latent prior with K=10 mixture components capturing distinct class clusters.

nodes.label: Homoscedastic Gaussian Likelihood
nodes.rationale: Continuous Gaussian observation model with uniform fixed noise variance sigma^2=1.0, reducing NLL to pixel-wise MSE.

nodes.label: L2 Conditional Mean Smoothing Trap
nodes.rationale: Mathematical phenomenon where minimizing expected L2 error forces the model to output the conditional mean E[x|z], creating blurry images.

nodes.label: Spherical Prior Concentration
nodes.rationale: Geometric phenomenon where Gaussian probability mass in high dimensions (d=512) concentrates in a thin spherical shell.

nodes.label: Active Latent Units (Az)
nodes.rationale: Count of latent dimensions whose posterior mean variance Var_x(E_q[z_j]) exceeds 0.01.

nodes.label: Group Normalization (GroupNorm)
nodes.rationale: Per-sample channel grouping normalization eliminating batch size dependencies during single-sample generative sampling.

nodes.label: Fréchet Inception Distance (FID)
nodes.rationale: Distributional metric measuring Wasserstein-2 distance between real and synthetic Inception-v3 feature embeddings.

nodes.label: Inception Score (IS)
nodes.rationale: Metric evaluating generative sharpness and class diversity via exponential of expected KL divergence.

nodes.label: Beta-NLL Loss Weighting
nodes.rationale: Loss downweighting using detached variance (sigma^(2*beta)) to prevent variance cheating on high-frequency edges.

nodes.label: Heteroscedastic Gaussian Likelihood
nodes.rationale: Pixel-wise adaptive uncertainty model predicting both mean mu(z) and spatial log-variance map log sigma^2(z).

nodes.label: Full Correlated Covariance Posterior
nodes.rationale: Low-rank plus diagonal factor analysis covariance Sigma = V*V^T + diag(sigma^2) modeling latent coordinate correlations.

nodes.label: Continuous Gaussian Reparameterization
nodes.rationale: Differentiable latent sampling mechanism expressing latent random variables as deterministic affine transformation z = mu + sigma * eps.
